character: MY SUGAR BABY IS A BILLIONAIRE

text: INT. HARRIS’ MANSION - BEDROOM - DAY1 1

The sound of heavy breathing gradually fills the room. Clothes are scattered across the floor. SERENA’s hand’s gripping the silky bedsheets. Serena’s fingers trail along JULIAN’s chiseled back, stopping to brush the nape of his neck.
You’re amazing... I’m not sure I’m ready for this to end.
JULIAN leans closer, his voice is deep and sexy.
Then let’s keep going.
Better save your energy for your next sugar mama. Serena pushes him gently away and begins dressing. Julian sits up, puzzled.
What’s that supposed to mean? Serena hooks a finger around his belt, pulling him close. Her fingers brush across his defined abs.
But I’ll miss you, Babe...I can’t believe it’s been 3 years... How much do I owe you?
She pulls a sleek bank card out from her purse and hands it to him.
Here’s one million for the past three years. Take it and we’ll call it even. Julian grabs her wrist, his voice sharp with disbelief.
Wait a minute, are you dumping me? Serena runs a finger across his chest, leaving him visibly unsettled.
It’s been fun, darling. (tucks the card into his waistband) ) But too bad my husband’s coming back...
She picks up her purse, blows him a kiss, and strides out.
Don’t miss me too much. Bye. Serena exits. Julian stands frozen for a moment before throwing the bank card onto the floor, his expression darkening.
Serena! This isn’t over!
His phone buzzes. He picks it up.
Sir, should I come to pick you up? Julian glances out the window, watching Serena’s car speed away.
Yes, follow her. I’d like to see who she’s running back to.
EXT. AIRPORT PARKING LOT - DAY2 2
Serena leans against her car, her sunglasses shielding her expression. CHAD approaches, one arm draped around BIANCA, the other dragging a suitcase.
Hey Serena! I didn’t expect you to pick us up.
“Us”? I’m here for my husband. I don’t recall signing up for two... But you do look like a man... Chad places the suitcase in the trunk, his protective arm tightening around Bianca.
Watch your words, Serena. Bianca’s carrying my baby. Show some respect. Serena stares at the two in shock and anger.
What?!...She’s carrying YOUR child, not mine! Yes, we agreed to an open marriage, not an open daycare!!You Sleazy pig!
She yanks the car door open.

I agreed to pick you up, but I never said I’d drive you home. (gets in car, slams the door) Bye-bye, assholes! Serena floors the gas pedal, she flashes a middle finger at them through the window, the car screeching away. The trunk pops open mid-drive, spilling the suitcase onto the ground.
Serena! God damn it! From a car parked nearby, Julian observes the scene with a sulky face.
You left me for “this”?
That’s Chad Wilson— heir to the Wilson conglomerate. Julian adjusts the ring on his little finger with a calculating expression.
Let’s teach the Wilson family a little lesson so she understands what a mistake she’s making.
INT. WILSON’S MANSION - HOME OFFICE - NIGHT3 3
William slams a stack of papers onto his desk, glaring at Chad.
What the hell have you done? Mr. Harris pulled all his investment the moment you returned from Europe! Chad shrugs dismissively.
So? He’s just one of them. We’ve got other investors.
“So”? He’s not just any investor! His influence keeps our company afloat. If he’s out, so are the others. Serena steps in, her tone measured and calm.
William... Stress isn’t good for your heart.
Thank you, Serena. I wish Chad had your sense. Serena helps him sit. Chad scowls at her.
Am I your kid or is she?
Frankly, I’d prefer her as my heir.
Mr. Harris is hosting a gala tomorrow night. You’re gonna go fix this mess! He turns to Serena with a gentle pleading look.
Serena, will you attend with him?
Of course, William. Anything for the family. As William leaves, Serena gets up to go, giving Chad a dirty look. Chad grabs Serena’s wrist.
Always the perfect daughter-in-law, aren’t you?
And you, are still the good-for- nothing son!
She yanks her arm free and walks out.
INT. WILSON’S MANSION - BEDROOM - NIGHT4 4
Serena walks out of the bathroom wrapped in a towel, only to find Chad sitting on the edge of the bed.
Get out!
It’s been a while, don’t you miss your hubby? Serena crosses her arms, her tone gets icy.
The only reason I married you was to follow my father’s will. Remember that. Chad rises, his eyes trailing over her as he steps closer.!!
I got that, but up to this moment, I’m still your husband. Serena smirks bitterly, stepping back as she tosses her hair over her shoulder.
Three years, Chad. That’s all it takes for me to get my inheritance. I’m gonna divorce your sorry ass as soon as it’s time! Suddenly, Chad grabs Serena roughly, pulling her against him.
Then I better make the most of my time with you. He leans in to kiss her, but Serena’s hand comes up fast delivering a sharp slap across his face.
INT. WILSON’S MANSION - BEDROOM - NIGHT5 5
Serena stands face-to-face with Chad, her anger boiling over.
Get the hell out of here!! Or I’ll tell William you got Bianca pregnant. He’ll kill you! Chad clutches his face, breathing hard, his rage barely contained.
Are you threatening me!?
We both know your father well enough. You go ahead, give it a try! Chad lets her go, storms toward the door, fuming. Serena’s phone buzzes on the nightstand. The screen is on.
The caller ID reads “Sugar Baby.” She hesitates, then answers.
Hey, babe. Chad pauses at the doorway. Hearing her tone, he turns back.
(loudly, suspicion in his eyes) Who are you talking to? A guy or a girl? Serena covers the phone’s mic and glares at Chad.
None of your business. Get out!
INT. HARRIS’ MANSION - NIGHT6 6
Julian, holding a phone, freezes. His eyes widen as he hears Chad’s muffled voice in the background.
I just heard a man’s voice. Who is he?!
INT. WILSON’S MANSION - BEDROOM - NIGHT7 7
Serena rolls her eyes, completely unfazed.
Of course it’s my husband.
What are you doing with him?! Serena, what am I to you?!
A kept ex-lover. What did you think? You don’t get a say in what I do with my husband. Serena hangs up the phone, cutting Julian off mid-response.
INT. HARRIS’ MANSION - MASTER SUITE - NIGHT8 8
Julian throw his cell phone aside with anger. Martin walks in.
Sir, the Wilsons have RSVP'd for tomorrow. Julian’s lips curl into a sly smile.
Perfect. Tomorrow, Serena will learn exactly what she’s giving up. Julian holds tight the ring on his little finger.
You gonna have to beg me back, baby.
INT. HARRIS’ MANSION - ENTRANCE - NIGHT9 9
Serena steps into the mansion, her gown glimmering under the mansion’s lights. Chad walks pass Serena with Bianca. Bianca clutches his arm.
Serena, I hope it’s OK I’m tagging along.
You think this is a casual dinner party or something? Chad, I doubt Mr. Harris will welcome uninvited guests. Serena turns and strides confidently into the mansion, leaving Chad and Bianca flustered.
INT. HARRIS’ MANSION - BANQUET HALL - NIGHT10 10
Serena stands amidst a group of elite guests, her charm on full display.
Have you met Mr. Harris? It’s said that he’s super handsome.
Handsome? His wealth and power are what matter. He’s the most wanted sponsor for even president elections! Guest A grabs Serena’s wrist.
We just care the unforgettable handsome face, don’t we?
If unforgettable faces are your thing,
Mr. Harris has competition.
INT. HARRIS’ MANSION - NIGHT11 11
Serena pulls Julian’s tie, their faces inches apart.
INT. HARRIS’ MANSION - BANQUET HALL - NIGHT12 12
The banquet hall’s doors swing open. A hush falls as Julian enters, exuding magnetism and authority.
There he is — Mr. Harris! Serena looks over and freezes.
INT. HARRIS’ MANSION - BANQUET HALL - NIGHT13 13
Serena scans the room, speaking to herself with a determined tone.
Mr. Harris is such a popular man. I just have to meet him. Serena starts moving forward. Julian’s face emerges from the crowd. She freezes. Loud heartbeats muffle all other sounds.
He’s... Mr. Harris? Serena’s eyes stay glued to Julian as he navigates the crowd, smiling politely and mingling with guests, completely ignoring her.
(whispers to herself in disbelief) Wait, is this a dream?… Serena nervously pulls out her phone, scrolling to a contact named “sugar baby”.
She dials. The phone rings as Julian continues his charming conversations. She exhales, relieved, and turns away.
There’s no way Julian is Mr. Harris. Probably they just look alike —
The line suddenly connects. Julian’s cold voice cuts through the air.
Speak. Serena spins around in shock. Julian stands in the crowd, phone to his ear, staring coldly at her.
This... This can’t be real.
Her phone slips from her trembling hand and crashes to the floor.
My sugar baby... is Mr. Harris, the billionaire? Three years... why would he hide this from me? Their eyes lock across the crowd in the room.
INT. HARRIS’ MANSION - BANQUET HALL - NIGHT14 14
Julian breaks away from the crowd and walks toward Serena. He picks up her phone and hands it over.
Miss, you dropped this. Serena stares at him, stunned.
INT. BAR - NIGHT15 15
Text: Three Years Ago Serena, tipsy, stumbles off a barstool, dropping her phone. Julian picks it up.
Miss, you dropped this. Serena, dazed, touches Julian’s face.
Oh my god, did I just run into a fallen angel? You’re gorgeous.
She grabs his tie, pulling him close with a dreamy smile.
The world sucks, but don’t you worry— I’ll take care of you. Julian looks surprised, then grins as she hugs him. They kiss passionately.
INT. HARRIS’ MANSION - BANQUET HALL - NIGHT16 16
Chad pushes through the crowd, overly polite.
Thank you, Mr. Harris! Chad reaches for the phone, but Julian deftly turns his wrist, offering it to Serena instead. He glares briefly at Chad before focusing on Serena.
Uh, thank you.
Mr. Harris, do you know my wife? Julian leans closer, studying Serena with a smirk.
She looks familiar. Yeah, like… from my bed? Serena’s eyes widen in panic.
INT. HARRIS’ MANSION - BANQUET HALL - NIGHT17 17
What!? You and my wife...!? Julian watches Serena’s alarmed expression and chuckles smugly.
Oh, my bad. Wrong person. My partner is way sexier and... fiery. Chad laughs awkwardly.
I knew it! Easy mistake to make, Mr. Harris. It happens to the best of us. Actually, I’m here to discuss the withdrawal of your investment—
Simple. Your family is just not my favorite.
Julian’s words are directed at Chad, but his eyes stay locked on Serena. Bianca interjects, stepping between Chad and Serena with an air of authority.
Mr. Harris, the Wilson Company has worked with you for years. You can’t just cut ties like this. Julian doesn’t even glance at Bianca, his gaze fixed on Serena.
Who’s more heartless, Mrs. Wilson? What do you think? Serena stammers, unsure how to respond.
Julian gives her a meaningful look before turning and walking away.
Damn! Why would Mr. Harris even notice her?
A waiter walks by with a tray. Bianca shoves Serena, causing her to stumble. Plates crash, and red sauce splatters across Serena’s dress.
OH NO, Serena fell! All guests turn to stare. Bianca smirks as Chad scolds.
Serena! Is it that hard to stand properly? Serena pretends to wobble as she stands, holding her head with hands.
Sorry, I might’ve hit my head. Feeling a bit dizzy... Suddenly, Serena falls onto Bianca, smearing the sauce all over her. She topples a cake onto Bianca in passing.
Oh my god!
Sorry! I just can’t stay upright... Serena grins mischievously as she stumbles. A jacket suddenly drapes over her shoulders. Julian appears, wrapping an arm around her.
Who did this to her?
INT. HARRIS’ MANSION - BANQUET HALL - NIGHT18 18
Bianca trembles, too scared to speak. Julian’s voice cuts through the air, cold and threatening.
Messing with my lady right in front of my face? Someone must have some kind of a death wish. Chad and Bianca look shocked and confused. Julian grabs Serena’s hand.
Let’s get you cleaned up.
No no, I can... Ignoring her protests, Julian sweeps Serena off her feet in a bridal carry, leaving the room as everyone stares in astonishment.
INT. HARRIS’ MANSION - HALLWAY - NIGHT19 19
Julian carries Serena toward a guest room. She whispers urgently.
Put me down now! People gonna get the wrong idea! Julian sets her down gently but corners her against the door.
After everything we’ve done, what’s left to hide? Mrs. Wilson. He pushes the door open and nudges her inside.
INT. HARRIS’ MANSION - GUEST ROOM - NIGHT20 20
Julian lifts Serena onto a cabinet by the door, planting his hands on either side of her.
I need to change. Do you mind step away a minute? Instead, Julian smiles and reaches for her zipper.
I’ve helped you dress before, remember?
The gown’s straps slide off her shoulders. Julian leans in, trailing kisses from her shoulder to her ear.
Stop... Though flustered, Serena’s resistance falters. Julian takes her hand, kissing her palm softly and rubbing his cheek against it.
Do you want me? Just say it, you can have it all.
INT. HARRIS’ MANSION - GUEST ROOM - NIGHT21 21
Serena pulls him into a heated kiss, her hands slipping under his shirt. Julian suddenly grabs her wrists, stopping her.
Wait, I’m not your sugar baby anymore. Why should I do this now? Serena, irritated and turned on, pushes him away.
Fine, forget it. You’re not the only man in the world.
She walks toward the door.
Do you have any idea how many women wanna be my girlfriend, Serena? Are you really turning me down?
Whomever wants you can have you. I don’t care!
She leaves without looking back.
Serena, you’ll be back begging, I promise.
INT. WILSON’S MANSION - LIVING ROOM - DAY22 22
Serena descends the stairs, ready for work. William rushes past her, looking panicked.
What’s happening, William?
Another shareholder pulled out! But don’t worry, I’ll handle it.
He hurries out. Serena looks concerned.
Is he really going to ruin the Wilson Company? Serena dials Julian on her phone.
INT. HARRIS’ CORPORATION - CEO OFFICE - DAY 23 23
Julian answers, his tone dripping with amusement.
Miss me already?
CUT TO
INT. WILSON’S MANSION - LIVING ROOM - DAY24 24
Can you stop targeting Wilson Company?! William didn’t do nothing wrong!
You seem to know exactly who’s at fault, huh?... Serena, come to me. You have no option— your family’s fate is in my hands.
INT. HARRIS’ CORPORATION - CEO OFFICE - DAY25 25
Martin opens the office door for Serena, then steps out and closes it behind her.
Here you are! Serena.
Can you just leave Wilson Company alone? William's health is failing— You are torturing him! Julian steps closer, a slow, deliberate move.
I’m more interested in torturing you. Maybe you should take his place.
If you’ll spare Wilson Company, I’ll do whatever you want. Julian leans casually against the coffee table, smirking as he watches her.
Take it off. Serena freezes, unsure if she heard him right.
What?
Strip... I used to serve you —now it’s your turn. Serena glances nervously at the partially open blinds.
Don’t do this... Julian straightens and turns to leave.
Fine! I’ll do it!
She takes a deep breath in with eyes shut, starts unbuttoning her blouse slowly, reveals her lingerie while looking at Julian.
You happy now? Julian’s expression hardens. He strides over and pulls her blouse closed.
That’s enough. You can leave now.
But the deal—
I said go. Serena leaves. Julian punches the wall in frustration.
She’d really go that far for that bastard?
Martin! Martin enters.
Go ahead put the money back to Wilson Company. That’s what I promised her.
EXT. MAGAZINE OFFICE - DOWNSTAIRS - DAY26 26
Serena walks toward the building. Suddenly, Julian’s car swerves to block her path. The window lowers, revealing his smug face.
I’ve resumed investing in Wilson Company. Don’t I deserve a thank-you?
Thank you, good master Harris. Let’s never meet again.
Oh? I bet you’ll be back begging me. Serena glares, hands on her hips.
Not a chance! Julian steps out, draping his coat over her shoulders. They’re inches apart now.
We’ll see.
INT. MAGAZINE OFFICE - CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY27 27
LANDON stands at the head of the table.
Today, we have a new team member joining us. Come on in! Bianca strides in confidently. Serena’s jaw drops.
Her?! Bianca scans the room, stopping on Serena with a sly smile.
Hi, everyone. I’m Bianca Foster.
Our cover story will be an exclusive interview with billionaire Mr. Julian Harris. Bianca will be in charge of this. Serena rises, frowning.
Bianca’s never done an interview. She’s not qualified! Bianca crosses her arms, stepping closer.
Do you have an issue with my decision?
I have an issue with her! Serena pushes Bianca into her seat.
This job needs someone more professional.
You think you’re the expert? Fine. Prove it. But what if you fail? Serena closes her notebook with a calm smile.
You’ll see. Bianca and Serena lock eyes in a silent battle of wills.
EXT. MAGAZINE OFFICE - DOWNSTAIRS - DAY28 28
Serena exits the building. Julian’s car idles nearby, his window down.
I was right. What I do for you?

character: INT/EXT. MAGAZINE OFFICE - JULIAN’S CAR - DAY29 29
text: Serena glares at Julian.
Does bullying me make you happy? Julian opens the car door, yanks her inside.
Seeing you surrender makes me happy.
Serena pulls herself free.
You’ve humiliated me before— Can we call it even?
Then why are you here now? Serena hesitates.
I’m here cuz’ I need to interview a jerk.
That’s not how you ask for a favor, Miss Rogers.
What do you want? Julian runs a finger along her cheek, tilting her chin up.
Impress me— like I used to impress you in bed.
In the car?!
Tick-tock. Three, two... Serena kisses him. Julian kisses back harder as her colleagues approach.
Where’s Serena? She was just here.
They search for her, her phone rings.
Oh no! Colleague A follows the sound of the phone ringing to search for Serena, leaning down to look inside the car window.
Inside the car, Serena lies on top of Julian, the two of them press closely together.
If they see us, they’d love knowing their star reporter is cozy up with Julian Harris.
He reaches for the window controls. Serena stops him, panicking.
No!
In desperation, Serena grabs Julian’s shoulders and kisses him hard. Julian smirks, pulling her closer and deepening the kiss.
Outside the car, Serena’s colleagues wander off, giving up the search. Serena shoves Julian away.
Get off me, asshole! Julian wipes lipstick from his mouth, amused.
Now I get why you’d keep me for three years— It’s quite the experience being served. Serena clears her throat awkwardly.
I’ve done my part. Now it’s your turn. Julian chuckles, enjoying her frustration.
See you tomorrow morning on Long Island Golf Course. Serena jumps out of the car, giving him a nasty look.
INT. GOLF COURSE - LOBBY - DAY31 31
Serena strides into the lobby, phone in hand.
I’m here. Where are you?
CUT TO
EXT. GOLF COURSE - DAY32 32
Julian, lounging in a chair with a smug grin.
I’m out on the course. Go to the receptionist and say exactly what I tell you.
Serena, rolling her eyes as she approaches the front desk.32A 32A
How can I help you, Ma’am?
I’m at the desk. Now what?
CUT TO
Julian, leaning on a golf club with a smug face.32B 32B
Tell her you’re my girl.
Serena’s face hardens. She walks away from the reception 32C 32C desk, lowering her voice.
Are you fooling me?!
CUT TO
Nope. It’s members’ family only. Admit it you’re my woman, or lose your shot. Your call.
INT. GOLF COURSE - LOBBY - DAY33 33
Serena hangs up, fuming.
Damn, he’s impossible!
After a moment of hesitation, she reluctantly approaches the desk again.
Hi, I’m...
She falters, biting her lip. The receptionist looks at her expectantly.
Yes? Serena pauses, weighing her options.
Ahh...Do I really have to do this?...
EXT. GOLF COURSE - DAY34 34
Julian checks his watch, sipping tea as he relaxes. Serena suddenly appears in front of him.
That was fast. How does it feel to be my woman? Serena smirks and pulls out a membership card waving in his face.
It turns out becoming a member is more affordable than being your woman. She tucks the card away, lifting her chin.
Now, Mr. Harris, shall we start the the interview? Julian claps mockingly, a smirk tugging at his lips.
Impressive. But unfortunately, you’re not my only option.
He steps aside, revealing Bianca seated behind him with a sly smile. She waves, smugly.
Huh, Who should I pick? Serena glares at Bianca, fire in her eyes.
EXT. GOLF COURSE – DAY35 35
Serena glares at Julian, exasperated.
You!... You’re still toying with me!
No, I’m giving you an opportunity. Julian gestures toward Bianca with a mocking flourish.
Ladies, since we’re on a golf course, how about a little competition? Whoever wins gets to do the interview. Bianca giggles and playfully taps Julian’s arm.
Mr. Harris, you’re so naughty! She leans in suggestively, but Julian shoves her away with obvious distaste.
Game’s on.
EXT. GOLF COURSE – LATER36 36
Serena and Bianca stand side by side, golf clubs in hand, as curious onlookers gather.
Don’t you know that golf is my forte? You’re so over!
I thought your forte was hooking up with guys. Bianca scoffs and steps up, swinging her club with precision.
The ball arcs beautifully through the air.
Wow!
Perfect shot! Bianca beams with satisfaction. Julian saunters up behind Serena and leans in close.

Looks like you’re in trouble. If I were you, I’d try bribing the judge. You know how much I enjoy being seduced. Serena turns her head sharply, their faces almost touching. Julian smirks, leaning in further with his eyes closed.
EXT. GOLF COURSE – DAY - CONTINUOUS37 37
Serena pushes Julian back with the handle of her club.
Guess what? It’s not over yet!
She steps forward, adopting a focused stance.
Text: two years ago
INT. CLUB - DAY38 38
Julian stands behind Serena on a golf course, guiding her hands.
Relax your shoulders. Swing through!
He patiently teaches her the perfect swing.
EXT. GOLF COURSE – DAY39 39
Serena swings. The ball soars, lands, and rolls into the hole in one smooth motion.
Hole in one!
The crowd cheers as Serena turns to see Julian clapping slowly, a sly smile on his face.
Three years together, all the details said he wasn’t just some sugar baby— I ignored all... Julian steps closer.
Congratulations on earning your interview. But the location is my choice.
He drapes an arm around Serena’s shoulder, leading her away.
We gonna go chat about the interview. Feel free to stay and practice some more, Bianca. Bianca seethes as they walk off, throwing her club down in frustration.
INT. HOTEL ROOM – NIGHT40 40
Julian lounges on the bed as Serena enters, crossing her arms.
This doesn’t feel like an appropriate place for an interview.
I said the location was my call.
He props himself up on an elbow, smirking.
I prefer discussing things in bed. Serena gives Julian a complex gaze.
INT. HOTEL ROOM – NIGHT - CONTINUOUS41 41
Serena leans in, Julian closing his eyes in anticipation. Serena chuckles softly and pulls back.
THE richest man in New York is so easy to fool. She steps away, towering over him with a confident glare.
You go through all this trouble just to get me in bed? What’s the difference from a spoiled brat throwing tantrums for candy.
I heard you staked your career on this interview. You’d better be nicer to me. Serena folds her arms, looking closely at him, unintimidated.

Pathetic! You can’t win a woman’s heart even with all that wealth and status, what’s so great about you, huh? Julian, furious, lunges forward, pinning her wrists above her head on the bed. He leans in, his voice low.
If I want to, you gonna be mine right now right here— your body and your heart. Serena smirks, unflinching.
As powerful as you are, all you’ve got is to push force on women? Sweetheart, that ain’t do any good... Julian moves as if to kiss her, but stops just short. Serena’s eyes remain closed, indifferent.
You can’t even look at me?
Go ahead. Assault me if you must. But don’t expect me to entertain your little games. Julian hesitates, then collapses against her, pulling her into an embrace.
Tell me how to win your heart... Love me, or losing everything you have. It’s your choice.
INT. HOTEL ROOM – NIGHT - LATER42 42
Serena strokes Julian’s neck.
It takes more than pleasing me in bed ... You gotta keep me happy all the time. Julian sits up.
You’re just tricking me into serving your whims. Serena slips off the bed, adjusting her clothes and grabbing her bag.
Suit yourself.
She walks to the door, then pauses and looks back.
But don’t meddle in my life again. If you enjoy hatred more than love.
She exits, leaving Julian frustrated, sitting on the bed. Martin enters.
Sir, shall I drive you home? Julian stares silently, his expression dark.
You don’t look good Sir... Didn’t you get what you wanted?
What I wanted? I’ve just become Serena’s pawn again!
He walks to the window, gazing out at the city lights.
I’m gonna get her this time!
INT. WILSON’S MANSION - LIVING ROOM – DAY43 43
Serena drags herself into the living room, visibly drained. Chad is heading out the door.
Oh, by the way, William suggests celebrating your birthday properly this year. What kind of gift do you like? Serena brushes past him without slowing down her pace.
Anything that’s not from you. Chad rolls his eyes and calls after her.
If William hadn’t brought it up, who’d care about a stupid birthday!
INT. WILSON HOUSE - BEDROOM – DAY44 44
Serena collapses onto her bed as her phone rings. She answers.
Your birthday’s coming up. What would you like to...?
(cutting him off)We’re just in a benefit-based relationship. No gifts necessary.
She hangs up before a reply.
INT. WILSON’S MANSION - DINING ROOM – DAY45 45
The dining table is laden with dishes. William smiles warmly at Serena.
Happy birthday, my dear.
Thank you for preparing all this, William. Chad walks in, grumbling as he pushes a fancy cake toward her.
Here’s the cake I ordered especially for you. What do you think? Serena stares at him, smiles bitterly.
I’m gluten free, remember? William turns at Chad.
How could you not know that? She doesn’t even eat bread! Some husband you are! Serena’s phone rings. She answers quickly.
Come outside. I’m waiting at your door. Even if you don’t want to—
Of course I do!
She grabs her things and rushes out.
EXT. WILSON’S MANSION - DOORSTEP – DAY46 46
Julian stands outside the gate. Serena sees a cake in his hand.
Not another cake! Do you all want me hospitalized for my birthday? Julian holds the cake with a smug smile.
This one’s flourless. I made it myself... Try it. Serena freezes, stunned. She dips a finger into the frosting, tasting it cautiously.
Hmmm, it’s...good. But it’s kinda ugly.
That’s what happens when I bake. I’m not a professional.
You made this? Yourself?
EXT. WILSON’S MANSION - OUTSIDE - DAY47 47
Serena and Julian eats the cake together.
I feel like I’ve had this before...
Text: three years ago.
EXT. WILSON’S MANSION - OUTSIDE - DAY48 48
Serena sees an ugly cake with candles burning on the steps in front of the door. She picks it up, puzzled.
EXT. WILSON’S MANSION - OUTSIDE - DAY49 49
Serena looks up at Julian.
So YOU are the one sending me a cake every year? How did you know I’m allergic to flour?... Julian seductively puts his arm around her shoulders.
Is that so surprising? I even know exactly how many moles are on your body. Suddenly, the door opens. William walks out and sees them. Serena quickly pushes Julian away.
Oh no! William’s gonna be so mad!
Serena, what’s going on? Serena lowers her head, feeling guilty.
How come you’re not inviting Mr. Harris inside? Serena looks at Julian in confusion.
INT. WILSON’S MANSION - DINING ROOM - DAY 50 50
Everyone is seated around the table. Julian sits next to William and across from Serena.
Mr. Harris, have you met Serena?
Hum yeah, Serena and I have been discussing an interview project. We‘ve had some good chats. Now we’re practically... Serena kicks Julian gently under the table.
